description: Located in the heart of the Gold Coast, this spacious contemporary home offers over 1,900 square feet of comfortable single-level living. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 2 en-suite baths, generous closet space, a large eat-in kitchen, formal living and dining rooms, and an adjacent den, the home is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Additional highlights include an attached 2-car garage and a prime location on one of the area's few streets with underground utilities. A rare opportunity to enjoy space, convenience, and modern comfort in an exceptional setting.
